page.layout: One printed page, blank apart from a woodcut ornament set in the upper middle of the page. No running text, page number, running head, catchword or signature. Mirrored show-through from the other side appears at the right edge and is left out.
page.notes: The woodcut is a decorative oval frame with grotesque figures, cherub or mask heads at top and bottom, and foliage at the sides. Inside the oval is an engraved scene: a hand holding a sword or pen-like object above a radiating burst of light, with clouds and a rocky base. It is an illustration, not printed text, so it is not transcribed. Only show-through from the reverse side is visible at the right edge and is excluded.
